data: original analytic mock plus original sigma=0.01 noise
initialization: same truth-derived source nodes and zero potential for every candidate
selection: Independently choose maximum finite full-dense local-Gauss-Newton evidence among converged fits on the identical candidate set; no truth or control-amplitude metric enters selection

evaluation.note: These are diagnostic comparison thresholds, not calibrated false-positive probabilities. Background error and local aperture integrals must also be reported.

limits: Finite development-chosen grid; source strength fixed; invalid candidates excluded with failures retained; upper-edge control choice is not an established continuous optimum; no nonlinear evidence or mass-uncertainty calibration. Policy recorded before fitting held-out seeds.
